description: QGISRed is a QGIS extension for constructing and analysing water-distribution models and digital twins, with manuals, training material, examples and a documented version history. This resource is provided by QGISRed project (qgisred.upv.es). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: Unknown; no resource-specific licence established from the accessed metadata. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The landing page calls it free software, but the exact licence was not established from this page. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
